Preserve sealed bindings during capability migration

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-62
  description: |-
    Keep validator-v2 Agent bindings and their active Operations unchanged when migration 0132 installs capability-manifest storage. Replay legacy bindings with their original v2 canonical and evidence digests, and permit runtime reuse only when the sealed runtime profile still matches and the current capability manifest is explicitly empty.
